purpose: Resume TRUE_HEADS_UP learning from the frozen 10105 ENS8 source without touching the divergent 3H semantic lane, using the already-validated HU fresh400 ensemble semantics.

training.teacher_route: Eight independent V1 Advantage members -> mean raw outputs -> unchanged lean regret matching.
training.fit_seed_contract: Reuse the already-validated fixed HU ENS8 init/batch seeds from lt3_hu_ens8_parallel_fit.py on every update.
training.root_behavior: Current HU ENS8 raw-output mean followed by unchanged lean regret matching.
training.roots_basis: Historical HU share round(600 * 0.4548) from the validated mixed LT3 trainer.
training.virtual_seed_iteration_note: Used only to preserve deterministic root deck/policy seed construction; it is not a shared global 3H/HU training iteration.
training.sampler: Resume the frozen 10105 sampler RNG state, then draw TRUE_HEADS_UP episodes only.

execution.fit_execution: 4 concurrent member processes x 8 Torch threads

hard_stop_conditions: Source checkpoint or source HU ensemble hash drift.
Any non-finite fit loss or non-finite model tensor.
Root collection count or domain mismatch.
Any mutation of frozen source artifacts.
Any THREE_HANDED training or reservoir mutation.
Runtime exception, worker failure, or failed resume integrity validation.
non_goals: No strength benchmark during the training block.
No HU semantic-architecture experiment in this block.
result: A completed block freezes a new research-only HU ENS8 teacher endpoint. It does not by itself establish strength improvement.
